title: Mom said dinner is at seven, but I'm already hungry now.
scene: 妈妈说七点吃饭，他现在就饿。

dialogue.speaker: Child
dialogue.line: Mom said dinner is at seven, but I'm already hungry now.

dialogue.speaker: Dad
dialogue.line: But you just had a snack a little while ago.

dialogue.speaker: Child
dialogue.line: Mom said I could only have a small snack.

dialogue.speaker: Dad
dialogue.line: Well, was your snack actually small?

dialogue.speaker: Child
dialogue.line: It was small... at least, small for me.

dialogue.speaker: Dad
dialogue.line: For you, maybe that is true.

dialogue.speaker: Child
dialogue.line: So can I please have just one more?

dialogue.speaker: Dad
dialogue.line: You will have to go ask Mom about that.

variations: "dinner's at seven" 换 "no TV till six"；"a small snack" 换 "one cookie"。
